sources.title: 关于深化新能源上网电价市场化改革 促进新能源高质量发展的通知（发改价格〔2025〕136号）
sources.authors: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局
sources.locator: 三、（五）新能源可持续发展价格结算机制的电量规模、机制电价和执行期限
sources.content: 新能源（风电、太阳能发电）上网电量原则上全部进入电力市场，上网电价通过市场交易形成；在市场外建立新能源可持续发展价格结算机制（机制电价差价结算）。以2025年6月1日为界区分存量与增量：2025年6月1日以前投产的存量项目，机制电价按现行价格政策执行、不高于当地煤电基准价；2025年6月1日起投产的增量项目，机制电价由各地每年组织竞价形成，执行期限按同类项目回收初始投资的平均期限确定。各地须在2025年底前出台并实施具体方案；纳入机制的电量不重复获得绿证收益；不得将配置储能作为新建新能源项目核准、并网、上网等的前置条件。文件落款日期2025年1月27日，2025年2月9日发布。

sources.title: US clean energy tax credits after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (P.L. 119-21): §25D, §48E and §45Y
sources.authors: Internal Revenue Service; U.S. Department of the Treasury
sources.locator: FS-2025-05 FAQ 1 and 7; Notice 2025-42 sections 1-3 and 6
sources.content: Public Law 119-21 (July 4, 2025), commonly known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), accelerated termination of clean energy credits. Residential clean energy credit (section 25D): not allowed for expenditures made after December 31, 2025; an expenditure is treated as made when original installation is completed. Clean electricity investment credit (section 48E) and production credit (section 45Y) for applicable wind and solar facilities: terminated for facilities placed in service after December 31, 2027, unless construction began on or before July 4, 2026. Under IRS Notice 2025-42 (effective for facilities whose construction did not begin before September 2, 2025), beginning of construction must be shown with the Physical Work Test; the Five Percent Safe Harbor is available only for low output solar facilities of 1.5 MW AC or less. Energy storage technology is excepted from the wind and solar termination rule. This is a summary of primary sources, not tax advice.
sources.license_note: U.S. federal government publication, generally public domain; cite IRS.gov as the source.
